summary: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state.
takeaways: We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged.
MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP.
MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks.
